cities.name: Tweed Heads
cities.tagline: Twin-town gateway where the Tweed River meets the Gold Coast surf
cities.general: Tweed Heads sits on the New South Wales–Queensland border with river walks, Point Danger views, and easy access to hinterland national parks and Gold Coast beaches.
activities: Cruise or paddle the Tweed River
tips: Weekend traffic builds on the highway
Book river tours in school holidays

cities.name: Ballina
cities.tagline: Richmond River town of beaches, lighthouse walks, and hinterland access
cities.general: Ballina is a north-coast river and surf town with Lighthouse Beach, the Richmond River, markets, and a practical base for Byron hinterland and coastal drives.
tips: Summer parking is tight near beaches

cities.name: Grafton
cities.tagline: Clarence River city of jacarandas, heritage streets, and hinterland roads
cities.general: Grafton is a Clarence River service town known for jacaranda season, heritage streetscapes, river crossings, and access to hinterland parks and the Pacific coast.
activities: Day-trip to Yamba or the hinterland
tips: A car helps for hinterland parks

cities.name: Cessnock
cities.tagline: Hunter Valley wine-town base for cellar doors and vineyard cycling
cities.general: Cessnock is the practical town hub of the Hunter Valley, with cellar doors, restaurants, balloon flights, and cycling routes through vineyard country.

cities.name: Singleton
cities.tagline: Hunter River town between vineyards, ranges, and coal-country roads
cities.general: Singleton sits on the Hunter River between wine country, national-park ranges, and inland highway routes, with a compact town centre and nearby lookouts.
activities: Use as a Hunter Valley side base

cities.name: Inverell
cities.tagline: Sapphire-country New England town of parks, fossicking, and granite hills
cities.general: Inverell is a New England tablelands town known for sapphires, parks, nearby fossicking, and granite-hill landscapes on inland New South Wales routes.
activities: Visit town parks and the river

cities.name: Moree
cities.tagline: North-west artesian spa town on the Gwydir floodplain
cities.general: Moree is known for artesian hot mineral pools, wide inland streets, and a practical stop on north-west New South Wales touring routes.
activities: Use as an inland touring base
tips: Book spa sessions in peak periods

cities.name: Narrabri
cities.tagline: Namoi River town below Mount Kaputar's volcanic plugs
cities.general: Narrabri sits on the Namoi plains below Mount Kaputar, with a compact service town, dark-sky access, and day trips into volcanic national-park country.
tips: Park roads can close after rain

cities.name: Mudgee
cities.tagline: Heritage wine town of cellar doors, food, and Cudgegong River walks
cities.general: Mudgee is a compact inland wine and food town with heritage streets, cellar doors, markets, and easy cycling between vineyards and the Cudgegong River.

cities.name: Lightning Ridge
cities.tagline: Outback opal town of mines, artesian baths, and desert night skies
cities.general: Lightning Ridge is a remote opal-mining town with fossicking fields, artesian bore baths, quirky galleries, and big-sky outback nights.
activities: See the Chambers of the Black Hand

cities.name: Bourke
cities.tagline: Darling River outback town at the edge of the back of Bourke
cities.general: Bourke is a classic Darling River outback town with river history, paddle-steamer stories, and a launch point for remote north-west New South Wales touring.
activities: Visit the Back O' Bourke Exhibition Centre
Drive nearby outback roads if prepared
tips: Fuel and water stops are sparse

cities.name: Cooma
cities.tagline: Snowy Mountains service town for alpine roads and ski-field access
cities.general: Cooma is the main eastern gateway to the Snowy Mountains, with alpine history, highway services, and routes to Jindabyne, Kosciuszko, and high-country walks.
tips: Weather changes quickly in the alps

cities.name: Jindabyne
cities.tagline: Lake and alpine town below Kosciuszko ski fields and summer trails
cities.general: Jindabyne sits beside Lake Jindabyne as the main base for Thredbo, Perisher, summer alpine walking, mountain biking, and Kosciuszko National Park access.
activities: Drive to Charlotte Pass or Thredbo
Visit the national park in summer

cities.name: Batemans Bay
cities.tagline: Clyde River holiday town for beaches, oysters, and south-coast parks
cities.general: Batemans Bay is a south-coast river-mouth town with beaches, oyster leases, river cruises, and access to Murramarang and nearby coastal national parks.

cities.name: Narooma
cities.tagline: South-coast inlet town for Montague Island, beaches, and rock fishing
cities.general: Narooma sits on a tidal inlet with beaches, a famous golf-course view, Montague Island tours, and easy access to Gulaga and coastal walking.
tips: Book in whale and seal seasons
Parking is limited near the inlet

cities.name: Eden
cities.tagline: Twofold Bay whaling-history town and killer-whale lookout country
cities.general: Eden sits on Twofold Bay with whale-watching history, Killer Whale Museum stories, coastal lookouts, and access to Ben Boyd and South East Forests parks.
tips: A car is needed for park access

cities.name: Merimbula
cities.tagline: Sapphire Coast lake-and-beach town for oysters, inlets, and coastal walks
cities.general: Merimbula combines a tidal lake, surf beaches, oyster leases, and a compact holiday centre on the Sapphire Coast.
activities: Visit nearby Pambula or Tura Head

cities.name: Bowral
cities.tagline: Southern Highlands garden town of cool-climate food and heritage streets
cities.general: Bowral is a Southern Highlands town known for gardens, autumn colour, food, Bradman history, and nearby Morton and Budderoo plateau walks.

cities.name: Lithgow
cities.tagline: Western Blue Mountains industrial town for Glow Worm Tunnel and pagoda country
cities.general: Lithgow sits west of the Blue Mountains with industrial heritage, nearby state forests, the Glow Worm Tunnel, and sandstone pagoda landscapes.
tips: Weather is colder than the coast

cities.name: Taree
cities.tagline: Manning River town between beaches, hinterland, and mid-north coast parks
cities.general: Taree is a Manning River service town with riverside parks, nearby beaches at Old Bar and Diamond Beach, and hinterland access toward Wingham and the Comboyne plateau.
tips: River parks flood after heavy rain

cities.name: Forster
cities.tagline: Twin-town lakeside base for beaches, Booti Booti, and dolphin cruises
cities.general: Forster and Tuncurry sit on a coastal lake entrance with surf beaches, Booti Booti National Park, dolphin cruises, and easy island and headland walks.

cities.name: Nelson Bay
cities.tagline: Port Stephens harbour town for dolphins, dunes, and Tomaree headland
cities.general: Nelson Bay is the main Port Stephens base, with dolphin cruises, Stockton sand dunes, Tomaree Head, and sheltered harbour beaches.

cities.name: Bellingen
cities.tagline: Creative hinterland town below Dorrigo rainforest and the Bellinger River
cities.general: Bellingen is a leafy hinterland town of markets, music, river swimming holes, and a gateway to Dorrigo National Park and Waterfall Way.

cities.name: Nambucca Heads
cities.tagline: Mid-north coast headland town of river mouth views and quiet beaches
cities.general: Nambucca Heads sits where the Nambucca River meets the sea, with headland lookouts, a historic breakwall, and quieter beaches than larger holiday towns.
activities: See the river mouth from lookouts
tips: A car helps for nearby beaches

cities.name: Castlemaine
cities.tagline: Goldfields town of galleries, gardens, and Victorian streetscapes
cities.general: Castlemaine is a compact goldfields town with theatres, gardens, food, nearby bushland reserves, and easy links to Bendigo and Daylesford.

cities.name: Daylesford
cities.tagline: Spa-country town of mineral springs, gardens, and lake walks
cities.general: Daylesford is the heart of Victorian spa country, with mineral springs, Hepburn Bathhouse, Lake Daylesford, gardens, and nearby forest walks.
tips: A car helps for surrounding springs

cities.name: Portland
cities.tagline: Western Victorian port of cliffs, maritime history, and whale lookouts
cities.general: Portland is a working harbour town with cliff walks, maritime history, nearby Cape Nelson, and seasonal whale watching on Victoria's far south-west coast.
tips: Distances to other towns are large

cities.name: Lakes Entrance
cities.tagline: Gippsland Lakes holiday town for boating, beaches, and inlet views
cities.general: Lakes Entrance sits where the Gippsland Lakes meet the Tasman Sea, with boat hire, inlet lookouts, Ninety Mile Beach access, and seafood.
activities: Walk the footbridge to the entrance
Hire a boat on the lakes

cities.name: Cowes
cities.tagline: Phillip Island township for penguin arrivals, surf beaches, and coastal walks
cities.general: Cowes is the main town on Phillip Island, with a sheltered bay beach, easy access to the Penguin Parade, Cape Woolamai, and coastal boardwalks.
tips: Weather is exposed on the south coast

cities.name: Mornington
cities.tagline: Peninsula bay town of beaches, wineries, and clifftop walks
cities.general: Mornington is a Port Phillip town with a harbour, beaches, nearby wineries, and access to the Mornington Peninsula's ocean beaches and national park.
activities: Walk the harbour and Main Street
tips: Weekend traffic from Melbourne is slow

cities.name: Bright
cities.tagline: Alpine valley town of autumn colour, rail trails, and high-country walks
cities.general: Bright is a north-east Victorian alpine-valley town known for autumn leaves, cycling, river swimming, and access to Mount Buffalo, Falls Creek, and Mount Beauty.
tips: Autumn and holiday weekends book out
Summer storms build in the ranges

cities.name: Beechworth
cities.tagline: Gold-rush granite town of honey, heritage streets, and gorge walks
cities.general: Beechworth is a preserved goldfields town with granite buildings, honey and beer, nearby gorges, and cycling links across north-east Victoria.
tips: Gorge walks are slippery after rain

cities.name: Apollo Bay
cities.tagline: Great Ocean Road harbour town for Otway rainforest and coastal walks
cities.general: Apollo Bay is a key Great Ocean Road stop with a working harbour, beaches, Otway rainforest drives, and the start of the Great Ocean Walk.
tips: Summer and holiday traffic is heavy
Weather is changeable on the coast

cities.name: Lorne
cities.tagline: Surf-coast village of waterfalls, pier walks, and Great Ocean Road bends
cities.general: Lorne is a compact Great Ocean Road village with a pier, surf beach, Erskine Falls, and rainforest walks into the Otways.
tips: Falls tracks are slippery after rain

cities.name: Port Fairy
cities.tagline: Historic fishing village of bluestone streets, islands, and shipwreck coast
cities.general: Port Fairy is a heritage fishing town with bluestone cottages, Griffiths Island, a working harbour, and access to the western Great Ocean Road.

cities.name: Halls Gap
cities.tagline: Gariwerd village base for Grampians peaks, waterfalls, and wildlife
cities.general: Halls Gap sits in a valley of the Grampians with trailheads, lookouts, kangaroos at dusk, and access to the Grampians Peaks Trail and waterfall walks.
tips: Summer heat and winter storms both matter

cities.name: Maroochydore
cities.tagline: Sunshine Coast river-mouth city for beaches, river cruises, and hinterland day trips
cities.general: Maroochydore sits at the Maroochy River mouth with patrolled beaches, river parks, and easy access to Noosa, the Glass House Mountains, and hinterland walks.
tips: A car helps for hinterland parks

cities.name: Caloundra
cities.tagline: Southern Sunshine Coast town of headlands, lagoons, and family beaches
cities.general: Caloundra wraps around headlands and Pumicestone Passage with family beaches, coastal walks, and views toward Bribie Island and the Glass House Mountains.
activities: Drive to the Glass House Mountains

cities.name: Gympie
cities.tagline: Mary Valley gold-town stop for heritage streets and hinterland drives
cities.general: Gympie is a Mary Valley service town with gold-rush history, a compact centre, and access to hinterland parks, Mary Valley railway country, and the Cooloola coast.

cities.name: Maryborough
cities.tagline: Mary River heritage city and mainland gateway toward K'gari
cities.general: Maryborough is a riverside heritage city with wide streets, colonial buildings, and a practical mainland base for Hervey Bay and K'gari ferry connections.
tips: A car helps for regional touring

cities.name: Yeppoon
cities.tagline: Capricorn Coast town for Great Keppel Island and headland walks
cities.general: Yeppoon is the main Capricorn Coast base, with beaches, headland walks, and boat access to Great Keppel Island and nearby coastal parks.
activities: Take a boat to Great Keppel Island

cities.name: Emerald
cities.tagline: Central Queensland sapphire and farm town on the Capricorn Highway
cities.general: Emerald is a central Queensland service town with sapphire-country access, a large lake, and a practical stop between the coast and Carnarvon Gorge.
activities: Use as a Carnarvon Gorge gateway

cities.name: Charters Towers
cities.tagline: Gold-rush inland city of wide streets and tropical dry-country heritage
cities.general: Charters Towers is a well-preserved gold-rush city west of Townsville, with grand buildings, underground mine tours, and dry-tropics inland touring.
activities: Take a mine or ghost tour
tips: A car is useful for outskirts

cities.name: Weipa
cities.tagline: Western Cape York mining town for bauxite country and remote gulf fishing
cities.general: Weipa is a remote Cape York town on Albatross Bay, known for bauxite mining, fishing, and a far-north base toward Mapoon and the Wenlock.
activities: Fish local waters with a guide
Drive surrounding Cape tracks if prepared

cities.name: Innisfail
cities.tagline: Wet-tropics river town between reef islands, waterfalls, and cane country
cities.general: Innisfail sits on the Johnstone River in the wet tropics, with art-deco streets, nearby waterfalls, and access to Etty Bay, Paronella Park, and coastal islands.

cities.name: Mission Beach
cities.tagline: Cassowary-coast village for Dunk Island, rainforest, and long beaches
cities.general: Mission Beach is a low-rise coastal village between rainforest and a long beach, with Dunk Island views, cassowary habitat, and access to the Family Islands.
tips: Marine stingers occur in warmer months

cities.name: Atherton
cities.tagline: Tablelands town for crater lakes, waterfalls, and cooler rainforest air
cities.general: Atherton is a Tablelands service town with crater lakes, waterfalls, waterhole swimming, and a cooler base above Cairns and the wet-tropics coast.

cities.name: Mareeba
cities.tagline: Dry-tropics tablelands town of wetlands, coffee, and savannah lookouts
cities.general: Mareeba sits on the drier side of the Tablelands with wetlands, coffee farms, savannah viewpoints, and a gateway toward Chillagoe and Cape York roads.
tips: The dry season is most comfortable

cities.name: Stanthorpe
cities.tagline: Granite Belt wine town of cool nights, orchards, and boulder country
cities.general: Stanthorpe is Queensland's cool-climate wine and orchard town, with granite tors, cellar doors, and access to Girraween National Park.

cities.name: Warwick
cities.tagline: Darling Downs heritage town on inland routes to the Granite Belt
cities.general: Warwick is a Darling Downs service town with heritage buildings, river parks, and a practical stop between Brisbane, Toowoomba, and Stanthorpe.

cities.name: Derby
cities.tagline: Kimberley tidal town for Horizontal Falls flights and boab country
cities.general: Derby is a Kimberley town on King Sound, known for huge tides, boab trees, and flight or boat access toward Horizontal Falls and the Buccaneer Archipelago.
activities: Visit Prison Tree and Windjana if touring
tips: Remote roads need a capable vehicle

cities.name: Kununurra
cities.tagline: East Kimberley irrigation town for Lake Argyle, gorges, and Mirima
cities.general: Kununurra is the east Kimberley hub, with Lake Argyle, Ord River cruises, Mirima National Park, and access toward Purnululu and El Questro country.
activities: Cruise Lake Argyle or the Ord
tips: Heat remains strong even in winter

cities.name: Halls Creek
cities.tagline: Kimberley crossroads town for China Wall and inland gorge country
cities.general: Halls Creek is a small inland Kimberley service town and a practical stop between Fitzroy Crossing, Kununurra, and the Bungle Bungle approach roads.
activities: Use as a Purnululu staging point
tips: Remote roads close in the wet

cities.name: Newman
cities.tagline: Pilbara mining town and southern gateway toward Karijini gorges
cities.general: Newman is a Pilbara mining town below Ophthalmia Range and a practical southern approach to Karijini National Park and inland iron-ore country.
activities: Visit the mine lookout if open

cities.name: Tom Price
cities.tagline: Pilbara highland town closest to Karijini's western gorges
cities.general: Tom Price is the nearest service town to western Karijini, with highland air, mine-country views, and trailheads toward Dales, Weano, and Hancock Gorges.
tips: Carry more water than you expect

cities.name: Denham
cities.tagline: Shark Bay town for Monkey Mia dolphins, shell beaches, and World Heritage bays
cities.general: Denham is the main Shark Bay township, with shell-block buildings, Francois Peron access, and the road to Monkey Mia's dolphin beach.

cities.name: Coral Bay
cities.tagline: Tiny Ningaloo village for walk-in reef snorkelling and turtle beaches
cities.general: Coral Bay is a small Ningaloo settlement where the reef sits close to shore, with snorkel beaches, manta tours, and a quieter alternative to Exmouth.
activities: Join a manta or turtle tour

cities.name: Pemberton
cities.tagline: Karri-forest town of tree lookouts, trout streams, and southern walks
cities.general: Pemberton sits among tall karri forest with climbing trees, forest drives, nearby Yeagarup dunes, and access to the Warren and Greater Beedelup parks.
activities: Climb the Gloucester Tree if open

cities.name: Manjimup
cities.tagline: Southern forest service town for truffles, tall timber, and Bibbulmun access
cities.general: Manjimup is a southern forest town with timber history, seasonal truffles, nearby karri and tingle country, and Bibbulmun Track resupply.

cities.name: Walpole
cities.tagline: Inlet town for tingle forest, the Tree Top Walk, and wild southern coast
cities.general: Walpole sits between inlets and tingle forest, with the Valley of the Giants Tree Top Walk, inlets, and access to Walpole-Nornalup National Park.
tips: Book the Tree Top Walk in peak times

cities.name: Cervantes
cities.tagline: Crayfishing village beside the Pinnacles and Turquoise Coast lagoons
cities.general: Cervantes is a small Turquoise Coast town and the usual base for Nambung National Park's Pinnacles Desert and nearby lagoon beaches.
tips: Fuel up before remote coast drives

cities.name: Jurien Bay
cities.tagline: Turquoise Coast town for sea lions, beaches, and quiet Indian Ocean days
cities.general: Jurien Bay is a low-key coastal town with beaches, a marina, nearby sea-lion tours, and a quieter stop on the drive north of Perth.
tips: Services are limited compared with Perth

cities.name: Murray Bridge
cities.tagline: Murray River service city for houseboats, cliffs, and wetland edges
cities.general: Murray Bridge is a practical Murray River city with river cliffs, houseboat access, and a stop between Adelaide and the Riverland.
activities: See the rail and road bridges
tips: A car helps for wetland reserves

cities.name: Clare
cities.tagline: Riesling Trail wine town in the Clare Valley hills
cities.general: Clare is the main town of the Clare Valley, with cellar doors, the Riesling Trail cycle path, and heritage main-street stops between rows of vines.

cities.name: Tanunda
cities.tagline: Barossa village of cellar doors, church steeples, and food streets
cities.general: Tanunda is a central Barossa town with church steeples, cellar doors, butchers and bakeries, and easy cycling between vineyards.

cities.name: McLaren Vale
cities.tagline: Coastal-edge wine town for Shiraz, beaches, and Willunga hills
cities.general: McLaren Vale sits between vines and the Gulf St Vincent, with cellar doors, the Shiraz Trail, and nearby Port Willunga cliffs and beaches.

cities.name: Kingscote
cities.tagline: Kangaroo Island's main town for harbours, wildlife, and island touring
cities.general: Kingscote is Kangaroo Island's largest town, with a harbour, coastal walks, and a practical base for Flinders Chase, Seal Bay, and island wildlife tours.
activities: Use as an island touring hub
tips: Book the ferry and cars early
Wildlife is most active at dusk

cities.name: Robe
cities.tagline: Limestone Coast fishing town of heritage cottages and wild beaches
cities.general: Robe is a limestone fishing town with heritage cottages, a working harbour, long beaches, and access to Canunda and Coorong country.
tips: Summer and cray season are busy

cities.name: Ceduna
cities.tagline: Far-west Eyre Peninsula town and last major stop before the Nullarbor
cities.general: Ceduna is a far-west South Australian service town on Denial Bay, with oyster leases, a practical Nullarbor staging point, and nearby coastal lookouts.
tips: Services thin out quickly west of town

cities.name: Burra
cities.tagline: Copper-triangle heritage town of mine ruins, cottages, and creek country
cities.general: Burra is a preserved copper-mining town in the mid-north, with mine ruins, miner cottages, a heritage passport trail, and nearby gorge country.
tips: Many sites are outdoors and exposed

cities.name: Hawker
cities.tagline: Flinders Ranges roadhouse town for Wilpena, Moralana, and outback lookouts
cities.general: Hawker is a small Flinders Ranges service town and a practical stop for Wilpena Pound, Moralana Scenic Drive, and surrounding outback lookouts.

cities.name: New Norfolk
cities.tagline: Derwent Valley town of hops, heritage, and Mount Field access
cities.general: New Norfolk sits on the Derwent above Hobart, with heritage buildings, hop-country history, and the main road toward Mount Field National Park.
tips: A car is needed for the park
Weekend traffic heads to Mount Field

cities.name: Huonville
cities.tagline: Huon Valley apple-country town for river, cider, and southern forest roads
cities.general: Huonville is the Huon Valley's main town, with river access, farm gates, cider, and roads toward Geeveston, Hartz Mountains, and the far south.

cities.name: Richmond
cities.tagline: Georgian village of Australia's oldest bridge and convict-era streets
cities.general: Richmond is a compact Georgian village near Hobart, with Australia's oldest bridge, galleries, tea rooms, and a popular day-trip streetscape.

cities.name: Deloraine
cities.tagline: Meander Valley town of crafts, murals, and Great Western Tiers views
cities.general: Deloraine is a Meander Valley town with murals, craft, river walks, and a gateway to the Great Western Tiers, Mole Creek, and Cradle Mountain roads.

cities.name: Stanley
cities.tagline: Fishing village beneath The Nut, with high-chair views and west-coast light
cities.general: Stanley is a tiny north-west fishing village beneath the volcanic Nut, with a chairlift or steep walk, heritage cottages, and wild coastal light.
activities: Climb or ride to The Nut
tips: Wind is strong on The Nut

cities.name: Bicheno
cities.tagline: East-coast blowhole town for penguins, granite, and Freycinet access
cities.general: Bicheno is an east-coast fishing town with a blowhole, penguin tours, granite foreshore, and a practical stop toward Freycinet and the Bay of Fires.

cities.name: Coles Bay
cities.tagline: Freycinet village for Wineglass Bay, granite peaks, and coastal camps
cities.general: Coles Bay is the small village gateway to Freycinet National Park, with trailheads for Wineglass Bay, Hazards Beach, and pink-granite peaks.
activities: Continue to the beach if time allows

cities.name: Palmerston
cities.tagline: Top End satellite city between Darwin, wetlands, and Litchfield roads
cities.general: Palmerston is a planned Top End city south of Darwin, with parks, a practical base for commuters, and easy highway access toward Litchfield and the rural hinterland.
tips: The dry season is most comfortable

cities.name: Mataranka
cities.tagline: Thermal-pool town on the Roper Highway in Elsey country
cities.general: Mataranka is a small Top End town known for thermal pools, paperbark forest, and Elsey National Park on the road between Katherine and the Gulf.

cities.name: Pine Creek
cities.tagline: Gold-rush crossroads town between Kakadu, Katherine, and the Daly
cities.general: Pine Creek is a small gold-history town at a Top End crossroads, useful as a stop between Kakadu, Katherine, and the Daly River road.

cities.name: Gosford
cities.tagline: Central Coast city of waterways, ridges, and Brisbane Water shoreline
cities.general: Gosford sits on Brisbane Water with ridge lookouts, waterway parks, and a practical Central Coast base between Sydney and Newcastle.

cities.name: Terrigal
cities.tagline: Central Coast surf village of headland walks and a curved beach
cities.general: Terrigal is a busy Central Coast beach village with a curved surf beach, The Skillion headland, rock pools, and cafe streets.

cities.name: Kiama Downs
cities.tagline: South-coast village near blowholes, coastal walks, and Minnamurra
cities.general: Kiama Downs sits just north of Kiama with beach access, coastal-walk links, and a quieter stay near the famous blowhole and Minnamurra rainforest.
tips: Weekend traffic from Sydney is heavy
Rainforest tracks are slippery after rain

cities.name: Ulladulla
cities.tagline: South-coast harbour town for beaches, headlands, and Murramarang parks
cities.general: Ulladulla is a working harbour town with beaches, coastal walks, and access to Murramarang National Park, Batemans Bay, and Milton's food streets.
tips: A car helps for park beaches

cities.name: Scone
cities.tagline: Horse-capital town of studs, hills, and Upper Hunter ranges
cities.general: Scone is the Upper Hunter's horse-country town, with studs, hills, and a stop on inland routes toward the Liverpool Range and Barrington country.

cities.name: Parkes
cities.tagline: Central-west town of the radio telescope, Elvis festival, and wide plains
cities.general: Parkes is a central-west service town known for the CSIRO radio telescope, wide plains, and a practical stop on inland New South Wales touring routes.
activities: Visit the radio telescope visitor centre
Use as an inland touring base

cities.name: Forbes
cities.tagline: Lachlan River gold-town of heritage streets and inland highway stops
cities.general: Forbes sits on the Lachlan River with gold-rush heritage, a compact centre, and a useful stop between Parkes, Cowra, and the western plains.
tips: River parks can flood after rain

cities.name: Deniliquin
cities.tagline: Edward River town of wetlands, sheep-country roads, and Ute Muster fame
cities.general: Deniliquin is a Riverina town on the Edward River, with river parks, nearby wetlands, and a service hub for western New South Wales and northern Victoria routes.

cities.name: Wodonga
cities.tagline: Murray twin-city with Albury for river walks, ranges, and Hume Highway stops
cities.general: Wodonga sits across the Murray from Albury, with river parklands, nearby ranges, and a practical twin-city base for north-east Victoria and southern New South Wales.
tips: The two-city layout needs a car or bus

cities.name: Ararat
cities.tagline: Western Victorian town between Grampians peaks and Pyrenees wine hills
cities.general: Ararat is a western Victorian service town with heritage streets and a practical base between the Grampians, Pyrenees wineries, and the Western Highway.

cities.name: Hamilton
cities.tagline: Western District wool town for volcanic plains and south-west touring
cities.general: Hamilton is a Western District service town on volcanic plains, useful for routes toward the Grampians, Portland, and the south-west coast.
activities: Continue to the coast or Grampians

cities.name: Rainbow Beach
cities.tagline: Coloured-sand village and barge gateway to K'gari
cities.general: Rainbow Beach is a small Cooloola-coast town of coloured cliffs, long beaches, and the Inskip Point barge to K'gari (Fraser Island).

cities.tagline: Town of 1770 and Agnes Water for reef trips and coastal national park
cities.general: The Town of 1770 and neighbouring Agnes Water sit at the southern end of the Great Barrier Reef, with quiet beaches, headland walks, and island trips.
activities: Take a reef or island trip

cities.name: Childers
cities.tagline: Heritage main-street town in Bundaberg cane and fruit country
cities.general: Childers is a compact heritage town on the Bruce Highway, with a famous main street, nearby farm stalls, and a stop between Hervey Bay and Bundaberg.
tips: A short stop still needs shade and water

cities.name: Ayr
cities.tagline: Burdekin cane town between Townsville, Bowen, and wetland edges
cities.general: Ayr is a Burdekin service town in cane country, with a practical stop on the Bruce Highway and access toward wetlands and the coast.

cities.name: Bowen
cities.tagline: Coral Coast mango town of quiet beaches and island views
cities.general: Bowen is a quieter Coral Coast town with beaches, island views, mango country, and a less crowded alternative to the Whitsundays strip.
tips: Services are smaller than Airlie Beach

cities.name: Cardwell
cities.tagline: Hinchinbrook Channel town for island views and waterfall hinterland
cities.general: Cardwell sits on the Hinchinbrook Channel with island views, a long foreshore, and access to waterfalls and the Thorsborne Trail boat transfers.
tips: Cyclone history still shapes the town

cities.name: Coolangatta
cities.tagline: Southern Gold Coast surf point on the New South Wales border
cities.general: Coolangatta is the southern Gold Coast surf town with point breaks, airport access, coastal walks, and an easy crossing to Tweed Heads.

cities.name: Surfers Paradise
cities.tagline: High-rise surf strip of patrolled beaches, nightlife, and coastal paths
cities.general: Surfers Paradise is the Gold Coast's high-rise beach strip, with a patrolled surf beach, foreshore paths, and easy access to hinterland rainforests.
activities: Ride the tram along the coast

cities.name: Redcliffe
cities.tagline: Moreton Bay peninsula city of jetties, beaches, and island views
cities.general: Redcliffe sits on a Moreton Bay peninsula with jetties, family beaches, coastal paths, and views toward Moreton Island and the bay.
tips: A car or train-bus link helps from Brisbane

parks.name: Namadgi National Park
parks.tagline: Canberra alpine-ash ranges, snow gums, and Namadgi ridgelines
parks.summary: Namadgi National Park protects mountain ranges, snow gums, historic huts, and walking country immediately south of Canberra.

parks.name: Dorrigo National Park
parks.tagline: World Heritage escarpment rainforest and Waterfall Way lookouts
parks.summary: Dorrigo National Park covers wet subtropical rainforest, waterfalls, and escarpment lookouts on Waterfall Way east of Armidale.

parks.name: Lamington National Park
parks.tagline: Gondwana rainforest plateaus, cliff walks, and Border Ranges views
parks.summary: Lamington National Park protects ancient rainforest, cliff-edge walks, and mountain lodges on the Queensland–New South Wales border ranges.

parks.name: Springbrook National Park
parks.tagline: Waterfalls, canyon lookouts, and glow-worm caves behind the Gold Coast
parks.summary: Springbrook National Park is a Gold Coast hinterland plateau of waterfalls, canyon lookouts, Antarctic beech, and cave walks.

parks.name: Girraween National Park
parks.tagline: Granite tors, wildflowers, and Bald Rock country on the Granite Belt
parks.summary: Girraween National Park is a landscape of granite domes, balancing tors, wildflowers, and walking tracks near Stanthorpe.

parks.name: Carnarvon National Park
parks.tagline: Sandstone gorge, palm pockets, and rock-art galleries in central Queensland
parks.summary: Carnarvon National Park is famous for Carnarvon Gorge, a deep sandstone system of palms, creeks, side gorges, and Aboriginal rock art.

parks.name: Eungella National Park
parks.tagline: Cloudforest plateau above Mackay with platypus pools and escarpment views
parks.summary: Eungella National Park sits on a high plateau west of Mackay, with rainforest, platypus-watching pools, and cool escarpment lookouts.

parks.name: Whitsunday Islands National Park
parks.tagline: Island peaks, fringing reef, and Whitehaven's silica beach country
parks.summary: Whitsunday Islands National Park protects forested peaks, bays, and beach camps across the island group off Airlie Beach.

parks.name: Great Sandy National Park
parks.tagline: K'gari dunes, coloured sands, rainforest pockets, and long surf beaches
parks.summary: Great Sandy National Park includes K'gari (Fraser Island) and Cooloola, with dunes, lakes, rainforest, and long 4WD beaches.

parks.name: Barrington Tops National Park
parks.tagline: Gondwana rainforest, subalpine plateau, and Hunter hinterland walks
parks.summary: Barrington Tops National Park rises from subtropical rainforest to a subalpine plateau of snow gums, swamps, and long walks.

parks.name: Wollemi National Park
parks.tagline: Vast sandstone wilderness of canyons, pagodas, and Wollemi pine country
parks.summary: Wollemi National Park is one of New South Wales' largest wilderness areas, with sandstone canyons, pagoda rock, and remote walking.

parks.name: Alpine National Park
parks.tagline: Victorian high country of snow plains, cattle-country huts, and peaks
parks.summary: Alpine National Park covers Victoria's high country, with snow plains, mountain huts, summer wildflowers, and winter ski access.

parks.name: Great Otway National Park
parks.tagline: Rainforest, waterfalls, and shipwreck-coast cliffs of the Otways
parks.summary: Great Otway National Park combines wet forest, waterfalls, Cape Otway lightstation country, and Great Ocean Road coastal cliffs.

parks.name: Port Campbell National Park
parks.tagline: Limestone stacks, arches, and the Twelve Apostles coast
parks.summary: Port Campbell National Park protects the famous limestone stacks, gorges, and clifftop walks of Victoria's shipwreck coast.

parks.name: Croajingolong National Park
parks.tagline: Wilderness coast of inlets, heath, and far-east Gippsland beaches
parks.summary: Croajingolong National Park is a long wilderness coast of inlets, heathland, beaches, and remote camps in far-east Victoria.

parks.name: Murray-Sunset National Park
parks.tagline: Mallee dunes, pink lakes, and remote north-west Victorian tracks
parks.summary: Murray-Sunset National Park protects mallee woodland, dunes, salt lakes, and remote 4WD tracks in Victoria's far north-west.

parks.name: Coffin Bay National Park
parks.tagline: Eyre Peninsula beaches, dunes, and wild limestone headlands
parks.summary: Coffin Bay National Park covers dunes, beaches, limestone headlands, and coastal wilderness west of Port Lincoln.

parks.name: Lincoln National Park
parks.tagline: Granite headlands, beaches, and memory-cove country near Port Lincoln
parks.summary: Lincoln National Park protects granite headlands, beaches, and coastal woodland on the southern tip of the Eyre Peninsula.

parks.name: Innes National Park
parks.tagline: Yorke Peninsula surf, lighthouses, and shipwreck beaches
parks.summary: Innes National Park occupies the toe of Yorke Peninsula with surf beaches, lighthouses, inland saline lakes, and shipwreck history.

parks.name: Coorong National Park
parks.tagline: Lagoon wilderness of dunes, birdlife, and the Murray Mouth
parks.summary: Coorong National Park is a long lagoon and dune system of birdlife, Ngarrindjeri country, and the Murray Mouth.

parks.name: Flinders Chase National Park
parks.tagline: Kangaroo Island wilderness of Remarkable Rocks, Admirals Arch, and wildlife
parks.summary: Flinders Chase National Park protects western Kangaroo Island's coastal sculptures, lighthouses, woodland, and abundant wildlife.

parks.name: Southwest National Park
parks.tagline: Tasmania's wild south-west of button grass, quartzite peaks, and rivers
parks.summary: Southwest National Park is a vast World Heritage wilderness of ranges, rivers, button-grass plains, and remote multi-day walks.

parks.name: Franklin-Gordon Wild Rivers National Park
parks.tagline: Rainforest rivers, Frenchmans Cap, and the Lyell Highway gorges
parks.summary: Franklin-Gordon Wild Rivers National Park protects wild rivers, rainforest, and the Frenchmans Cap massif in western Tasmania.

parks.name: Walls of Jerusalem National Park
parks.tagline: Alpine tarns, pencil pines, and dolerite walls on Tasmania's Central Plateau
parks.summary: Walls of Jerusalem National Park is an alpine wilderness of tarns, pencil pines, and dolerite ramparts west of Cradle Mountain.

parks.name: Mount Field National Park
parks.tagline: Russell Falls, tall forest, and alpine boardwalks close to Hobart
parks.summary: Mount Field National Park combines waterfalls, giant swamp gum forest, and alpine tarns within easy reach of Hobart.

parks.name: Tasman National Park
parks.tagline: Dolerite sea cliffs, Three Capes country, and Tasman Peninsula blowholes
parks.summary: Tasman National Park protects some of the world's highest sea cliffs, coastal heath, and the Three Capes walking country.

parks.name: Cape Range National Park
parks.tagline: Ningaloo hinterland of gorges, canyons, and reef-side beaches
parks.summary: Cape Range National Park backs Ningaloo Reef with limestone gorges, canyon walks, and beaches where the reef sits close to shore.

parks.name: Francois Peron National Park
parks.tagline: Red cliffs, white beaches, and Shark Bay 4WD lagoons
parks.summary: Francois Peron National Park occupies the Peron Peninsula with red cliffs, white beaches, inland lagoons, and 4WD-only tracks.

parks.name: Fitzgerald River National Park
parks.tagline: World-class wildflower coast of ranges, inlets, and rare plants
parks.summary: Fitzgerald River National Park is a globally significant wildflower wilderness of ranges, inlets, and southern ocean cliffs.

parks.name: Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park
parks.tagline: Cape to Cape limestone, caves, karri pockets, and surf points
parks.summary: Leeuwin-Naturaliste National Park follows the cape-to-cape coast of limestone cliffs, caves, beaches, and forest pockets.

parks.name: Yanchep National Park
parks.tagline: Near-Perth woodland, caves, koalas, and wetland boardwalks
parks.summary: Yanchep National Park is a close-to-Perth landscape of woodland, caves, wetlands, and introduced koala viewing.

parks.name: Judbarra / Gregory National Park
parks.tagline: Victoria River sandstone, boabs, and vast north-west ranges
parks.summary: Judbarra / Gregory National Park covers huge Victoria River sandstone country, boabs, gorges, and remote 4WD routes.

parks.name: Tjoritja / West MacDonnell National Park
parks.tagline: Red Centre ridges, waterholes, and Larapinta Trail country
parks.summary: Tjoritja / West MacDonnell National Park protects the West MacDonnell Ranges, waterholes, ochre cliffs, and much of the Larapinta Trail.

parks.name: Finke Gorge National Park
parks.tagline: Palm Valley red gorge and ancient cabbage palms west of Alice
parks.summary: Finke Gorge National Park is known for Palm Valley, a red sandstone gorge sheltering ancient red cabbage palms.

parks.name: Warrumbungle National Park
parks.tagline: Volcanic plugs, Breadknife ridge, and dark-sky observatory country
parks.summary: Warrumbungle National Park is a volcanic landscape of spires, the Breadknife, and one of Australia's best dark-sky parks.

parks.name: Oxley Wild Rivers National Park
parks.tagline: Gorges, waterfalls, and wild rivers on the New England escarpment
parks.summary: Oxley Wild Rivers National Park protects deep gorges, waterfalls, and wild-river wilderness east of Armidale and Walcha.

parks.name: Nightcap National Park
parks.tagline: Gondwana rainforest, Minyon Falls, and Nightcap Range walks
parks.summary: Nightcap National Park covers World Heritage rainforest, waterfalls, and ridge walks in the Nightcap Range behind Byron Bay.

parks.name: Morton National Park
parks.tagline: Southern Highlands plateaus, Fitzroy Falls, and Shoalhaven gorges
parks.summary: Morton National Park includes plateau lookouts, Fitzroy Falls, Bundanoon walks, and deep Shoalhaven gorges.

parks.name: Ben Boyd National Park
parks.tagline: Red-rock coastline, Light to Light walks, and Twofold Bay heath
parks.summary: Ben Boyd National Park protects red coastal rock, heath, historic ruins, and the Light to Light Walk near Eden.

parks.name: Mutawintji National Park
parks.tagline: Bynguano Range gorges, rock art, and far-west desert ranges
parks.summary: Mutawintji National Park is a far-west New South Wales range of gorges, permanent water, and important Aboriginal rock-art sites.

hikes.name: Light to Light Walk
hikes.tagline: Ben Boyd coastal walk between Boyds Tower and Green Cape
hikes.summary: The Light to Light Walk follows red coastal rock, heath, beaches, and historic ruins between Boyds Tower and Green Cape Lightstation.
tips: Check park alerts for fire or storms
hikes.start_instructions: Most walkers start at Boyds Tower south of Eden and finish at Green Cape.

hikes.name: Dove Lake Circuit
hikes.tagline: Boardwalk and lakeshore loop under Cradle Mountain
hikes.summary: The Dove Lake Circuit is an accessible loop of boardwalk, lakeshore, and rainforest beneath Cradle Mountain.
tips: Stay on boardwalks to protect vegetation
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Dove Lake car park after the Cradle Mountain shuttle.

hikes.name: The Pinnacle Walk
hikes.tagline: Stepped sandstone climb to the Halls Gap viewpoint
hikes.summary: The Pinnacle Walk climbs from Halls Gap through Wonderland sandstone to a classic Gariwerd lookout.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Wonderland car park above Halls Gap.

hikes.name: Mount Gower Track
hikes.tagline: Guided cloudforest climb on Lord Howe Island
hikes.summary: The Mount Gower Track is a guided climb through palm forest and cloudforest to the summit of Lord Howe Island.
tips: The walk is long and exposed in places
hikes.start_instructions: Guided groups start from the southern settlement end of Lord Howe Island.

hikes.name: Kings Canyon Rim Walk
hikes.tagline: Red sandstone rim circuit above Watarrka's canyon floor
hikes.summary: The Kings Canyon Rim Walk climbs steeply then circuits the canyon rim past the Garden of Eden and sheer red walls.
tips: Start at dawn in warm months
Carry more water than you think
The first climb is the steepest
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed rim-walk car park in Watarrka National Park.

hikes.name: Dales Gorge Walk
hikes.tagline: Karijini gorge loop of Fortescue Falls, Fern Pool, and rim views
hikes.summary: The Dales Gorge Walk links Fortescue Falls, Fern Pool, and a rim return through Karijini's red banded iron formations.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Dales Gorge day-use car park in Karijini National Park.

hikes.name: Cape Otway Lightstation Walk
hikes.tagline: Coastal woodland walk to the Otway lighthouse
hikes.summary: A short Great Otway walk through coastal woodland to Cape Otway Lightstation, with koala habitat and shipwreck-coast views.
tips: Koalas are often in roadside trees
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Cape Otway Lightstation car park off the Great Ocean Road.

hikes.name: Fitzroy Falls East Rim Track
hikes.tagline: Plateau lookouts above Morton National Park's sandstone gorge
hikes.summary: The East Rim Track follows the plateau edge from Fitzroy Falls visitor centre past multiple gorge lookouts.
tips: Combine with the west rim if time allows
hikes.start_instructions: Start at the Fitzroy Falls visitor centre in Morton National Park.

hikes.name: Border Track
hikes.tagline: Lamington plateau rainforest walk between O'Reilly's and Binna Burra
hikes.summary: The Border Track crosses Lamington's rainforest plateau between O'Reilly's and Binna Burra through World Heritage forest.
tips: Carry a headlamp for late finishes
hikes.start_instructions: Walkers usually start at O'Reilly's Green Mountains and finish at Binna Burra.

hikes.name: Toolona Creek Circuit
hikes.tagline: Waterfall gorge and Antarctic beech circuit from O'Reilly's
hikes.summary: The Toolona Creek Circuit follows a rainforest gorge of waterfalls before returning along the Border Track through Antarctic beech.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed circuit at O'Reilly's Green Mountains.

hikes.name: Wollumbin Summit Track
hikes.tagline: Steep rainforest climb of the Tweed volcanic plug
hikes.summary: The Wollumbin Summit Track climbs steep rainforest and rock to the remnant volcanic plug of the Tweed caldera.
tips: Check current access and cultural guidance before going
The climb is steep and slippery
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed national-park car park if the summit track is open.

hikes.name: Frenchman Peak Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep granite climb above Cape Le Grand's white beaches
hikes.summary: The Frenchman Peak Walk climbs a granite dome above Cape Le Grand for views of Lucky Bay, Thistle Cove, and the Recherche islands.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park inside Cape Le Grand National Park.

hikes.name: Bluff Knoll Walk
hikes.tagline: Stirling Range summit climb through cloud-forest heath
hikes.summary: The Bluff Knoll Walk climbs the Stirling Range's best-known peak through heath and cloud-prone slopes to a wide southern-ocean view.
tips: Carry warm layers even in summer
Dieback hygiene stations must be used
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Bluff Knoll car park in Stirling Range National Park.

hikes.name: Tarn Shelf Track
hikes.tagline: Alpine lakes and pandani above Mount Field's plateau
hikes.summary: The Tarn Shelf Track visits alpine lakes, pandani, and ski-field country above Mount Field, often combined with Lake Webster or Rodway Hut.
tips: Snow is possible in any season
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Lake Dobson at the top of the Mount Field road.

hikes.name: Russell Falls Walk
hikes.tagline: Short rainforest walk to Tasmania's most famous waterfall
hikes.summary: The Russell Falls Walk is an easy rainforest path from Mount Field visitor centre to the three-tier waterfall.
tips: The path is popular and easy
Continue to Horseshoe Falls if time allows
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Field visitor centre car park.

hikes.name: Spit Bridge to Manly Walk
hikes.tagline: Harbour bushland walk from The Spit to Manly Wharf
hikes.summary: The Spit to Manly Walk follows Sydney Harbour through bushland, coves, Clontarf, and headlands to Manly Wharf.
tips: Go at low tide for some rock sections
Buses or ferries connect both ends
hikes.start_instructions: Start at the northern end of Spit Bridge and follow the signed harbour track.

hikes.name: Manly Scenic Walkway
hikes.tagline: North Head and harbour-edge walk from Manly
hikes.summary: The Manly Scenic Walkway links harbour coves, North Head views, and coastal bushland around the Manly peninsula.
tips: North Head is exposed to wind
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Manly Wharf and follow signs toward North Head or The Spit.

hikes.name: Cape Hauy Track
hikes.tagline: Dolerite cliffs and sea stacks at the end of the Three Capes country
hikes.summary: The Cape Hauy Track runs from Fortescue Bay through coastal heath to one of Tasmania's most dramatic dolerite lookouts.
tips: Add time if combining with Fortescue Bay swimming
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Fortescue Bay car park on the Tasman Peninsula.

hikes.name: Hinchinbrook Lookout Walk
hikes.tagline: Short Cardwell-range lookout toward Hinchinbrook Island
hikes.summary: A short hinterland walk to a lookout over the Hinchinbrook Channel and island massif near Cardwell.
tips: Cassowaries may be on nearby roads
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed lookout car park west of Cardwell.

hikes.name: Mount Kosciuszko Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: High-country walk from Thredbo or Charlotte Pass to Australia's summit
hikes.summary: The Kosciuszko Summit Walk crosses alpine herbfields and metal walkway to the highest point on the Australian mainland.
tips: Weather can be severe in any season
The Thredbo chairlift shortens the walk
hikes.start_instructions: Most summer walkers start from the top of the Thredbo Kosciuszko Express chairlift.
